A '''shakudo sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper sword]] with [[shakudo alloy]]. Each hit heals the wielder, and it comes with [[Sweeping Edge]] I.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the copper item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|6}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 1000 durability, as strong as an [[iron sword]] and far more durable.

=== Intrinsics ===
The life steal intrinsic gives the wielder Regeneration III for 1 second after each hit, except against armor stands, boats, minecarts and sulfur cubes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/shakudo_weapon.json}}</ref> Intrinsics are stored on the item and applied as enchantments when it enters a player's inventory.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[shakudo alloy]], which lets the alloy be reused on a fresh copper item.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_sword.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Notes ==
* Shakudo tools reuse the stone tools' item IDs, so they cannot be melted down in a blast furnace.

{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}

Life steal no longer triggers on boats, minecarts and similar entities. Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
